1013.description: An underhand pulldown with a band, pulling toward the chest. It trains the lats and biceps.
instructions: Attach the band to a high anchor point, such as a pull-up bar or sturdy beam.
Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the band with an underhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms fully overhead, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Engage your lats and pull the band down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将弹力带固定在较高的锚点上，例如上拉杆或坚固的横梁。
面向锚点站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
反手握住弹力带，双手间距略宽于肩宽。
将手臂完全伸过头顶，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
收紧背阔肌，将弹力带向下拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1077.description: Standing leg raise to the side with one foot in a strap. It works the outer hip and stability muscles.
instructions: Put one foot in a strap and stand tall on the other leg, holding the anchor for balance.
Brace your core.
Sweep the strapped leg out to the side.
Pause briefly at the end.
Bring it back under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

1141.description: A squat while holding the straps overhead, working the legs and mobility of the shoulders and torso.
instructions: Hold the handles overhead with arms straight.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit back and down into a squat.
Keep your arms up and chest tall.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Do not let the lower back round.

1205.description: A seated one-arm cable row with a rotation of the torso. It trains the back and gives the core a twist.
instructions: Sit at a low cable with your feet braced and grab the handle with one hand.
Start with your torso turned slightly toward the cable.
Row the handle to your side while rotating your torso open.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back, then return slowly.
Do all reps, then change arms.

1269.description: Standing cable crossovers with the hands crossing in front. It trains the chest.
instructions: Stand in the middle of a cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the handles of the cables with your palms facing down and your arms extended straight out to the sides.
Keeping your arms straight, bring your hands together in front of your body, crossing them over each other.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position, keeping your arms extended.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站在缆绳机中间，双脚分开与肩同宽。
手掌朝下握住电缆手柄，手臂伸直至两侧。
保持双臂伸直，将双手放在身体前面，相互交叉。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置，保持双臂伸展。
重复所需的重复次数。

1333.description: Lie face down on a stability ball with your arms reaching forward and lift your torso. It strengthens the lower back and glutes with extra leverage.
instructions: Place the stability ball on the ground and lie face down on top of it, with your hips resting on the ball and your feet against a wall for stability.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, with your palms facing down.
Engage your core and slowly lift your upper body off the ball, keeping your back straight and your neck in line with your spine.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将稳定球放在地上，面朝下躺在上面，臀部放在球上，双脚靠在墙上以保持稳定。
将双臂伸直在身前，手掌朝下。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将上半身抬离球，保持背部挺直，颈部与脊柱成一直线。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1397.description: A standing calf raise where you lift your heels as high as you can. It builds the calf muscles.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward.
Raise your heels off the ground as high as possible, standing on your toes.
Hold the position for a moment, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾指向前方。
将脚后跟抬离地面，尽可能高，用脚趾站立。
保持该姿势片刻，然后慢慢降低脚跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1461.description: A full-depth barbell squat shown from behind. It builds the quads, glutes and core and is a great check of back and knee alignment.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Hold the barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps or rear delts.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you begin to lower your body down.
Bend at the knees and hips, pushing your hips back and down as if sitting into a chair.
Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Keep your knees in line with your toes and your weight in your heels.
Drive through your heels to stand back up, extending your hips and knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微向外。
将杠铃放在上背部，将其放在斜方肌或三角肌后束上。
当你开始降低身体时，启动你的核心并保持胸部挺直。
弯曲膝盖和臀部，向后和向下推臀部，就像坐在椅子上一样。
降低身体，直到大腿与地面平行或稍低于地面。
保持膝盖与脚趾对齐，并将重量放在脚后跟上。
通过脚后跟站起来，伸展臀部和膝盖。
重复所需的重复次数。

1525.description: The dip and drive part of the jerk, practised with a barbell on the shoulders. It trains a vertical dip and strong leg drive.
instructions: Rack the bar on your front shoulders and stand with feet hip-width apart.
Keep your torso upright and your core tight.
Dip a short way by bending your knees straight down.
Drive up explosively through your whole foot.
Settle back to standing and reset.

1589.description: A hopping drill where you flick one heel up to your glutes. It warms up the hamstrings and raises your heart rate.
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other foot lifted.
Hop lightly on your standing foot.
Kick your free heel toward your glutes each hop.
Land softly on the ball of your foot.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

1653.description: A dumbbell curl while balancing on one leg in a stork stance. It trains the biceps and balance.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Extend one leg behind you, balancing on the toes of that foot.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
将一条腿伸到身后，用脚趾保持平衡。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿并重复。

1717.description: A squat combined with a cable row, using a rope. It trains the lats and legs together.
instructions: Attach a rope to a cable machine at waist height.
Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Grasp the rope with an overhand grip, with your hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull the rope towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Keep your elbows close to your body and continue pulling until your hands reach your chest.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release the rope and extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将绳子连接到腰部高度的缆绳机上。
面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
弯曲膝盖，将身体降低至蹲姿，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
正手握住绳子，双手与肩同宽。
收紧核心并将绳子拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
保持肘部靠近身体并继续拉，直到双手到达胸部。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢松开绳子，并将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1781.description: Using a wall corner to lean into, you stretch both sides of the chest at once. The corner lets you control the depth easily.
instructions: Stand facing a wall corner and place a forearm on each wall at about shoulder height.
Step one foot forward and lean your chest into the corner until you feel a stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1845.description: Reverse crunch on a decline bench that curls the hips toward the chest and trains the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench and hold the top edge above your head.
Bring your knees up and bend them.
Curl your hips off the bench, drawing your knees toward your chest.
Lower back down slowly without swinging.
Keep the movement controlled throughout.

1909.description: Standing stretch with one heel on the floor and toes pulled up, lengthening the back of the thigh and calf.
instructions: Stand tall and step one foot forward, resting the heel on the floor with the toes pulled up.
Keep the front leg straight and the back knee slightly bent.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel a pull behind the thigh.
Keep your chest open and avoid rounding your spine.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1973.description: A partner gently draws your arms back to stretch the front of the shoulders.
instructions: Sit tall and put your arms behind you, palms facing down.
Have a partner stand behind and hold your wrists or forearms.
Ask them to lift your arms slowly until you feel a stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and chest open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then lower slowly.

2101.description: Crossing one foot in front and pressing the toes down to stretch the front of the shin.
instructions: Stand tall and cross one leg in front of the other.
Point the toes of the back foot against the floor and gently bend the knee until the shin and ankle stretch.
Hold a wall or chair for balance.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2165.description: A lateral band walk that strengthens the outer hips and glutes.
instructions: Place a band around your thighs or ankles and stand with your feet hip width apart.
Bend your knees slightly into a quarter squat.
Step sideways with the lead foot, keeping tension on the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting the feet touch.
Take 10-15 steps one way, then walk back the other way.

2293.description: A standing zottman curl against a preacher bench, curling up then turning your palms down to lower. Works the biceps and forearms.
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Place your upper arms against the preacher bench and keep your elbows slightly bent.
Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders while keeping your upper arms stationary.
At the top of the movement, rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing downward.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position, rotating your wrists back to the starting position as well.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
将上臂靠在牧师凳上，并保持肘部稍微弯曲。
将哑铃向上弯向肩膀，同时保持上臂静止。
在动作的最高点，旋转手腕，使手掌朝下。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置，同时将手腕旋转回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2357.description: A side-by-side form check for hip position during a deadlift, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructions: Stand with the bar over mid-foot and set your hips at a mid height before gripping.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your hips start above the knees and rise together with your shoulders.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

2485.description: A curl with a neutral grip that works the biceps and forearms.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing in.
Keep your elbows close to your torso.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Keep your wrists straight.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

2741.description: A standing EZ bar curl with a wide grip. Emphasises the biceps.
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip, hands wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary throughout the movement.
Curl the barbell up towards your shoulders by contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，反手握住杠铃，双手分开比肩宽。
在整个运动过程中，保持肘部靠近躯干，上臂保持静止。
收缩二头肌，将杠铃向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2805.description: A single leg dumbbell deadlift with the rear foot supported on a step box. Works the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in your right hand.
Place your left foot on a stepbox or elevated surface behind you.
Keeping your back straight and core engaged, hinge forward at the hips, lowering the dumbbell towards the ground.
As you lower the dumbbell, simultaneously lift your left leg behind you, maintaining a straight line from head to heel.
Lower the dumbbell until you feel a stretch in your right hamstring, then return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与臀部同宽站立，右手握住哑铃。
将左脚放在身后的台阶或高架表面上。
保持背部挺直，核心收紧，髋部向前转动，将哑铃放低至地面。
当你放下哑铃时，同时将左腿抬起到身后，从头到脚跟保持一条直线。
降低哑铃，直到感觉到右腿筋拉伸，然后回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

2869.description: A rocking Pilates move on your belly that builds back extensor strength and control.
instructions: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders and legs together.
Press up into a swan, lifting your chest off the mat.
Let your arms float forward as you rock your chest and legs up.
Rock back and forth in a smooth, controlled rhythm.
Keep your neck long and your abs gently drawn in.

2933.description: Alternating rear lunges while making waves with heavy ropes. It combines leg work with a hard cardio effort.
instructions: Stand holding the ends of the battle ropes, feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back into a lunge while making a wave with the ropes.
Push through your front heel to return to standing.
Alternate legs, keeping the rope waves going.
Work for a set time, then rest.

2997.description: A pull-up where a band under your foot or knee takes some of your weight, so you can build up to full reps.
instructions: Loop a band over the pull-up bar and place a foot or knee in it.
Grab the bar with an overhand grip a little wider than your shoulders.
Hang with your arms long and your shoulders engaged.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
Use a thinner band as you get stronger.

3125.description: A seated ankle drill where you turn the foot outward against a band. It strengthens the outer ankle muscles.
instructions: Sit with one leg out and a band looped around the forefoot.
Anchor the other end to a fixed point on the inside.
Keep your heel still on the floor.
Turn your foot outward against the band.
Return slowly to the start.
Complete your reps, then switch feet.

3253.description: A standing side bend that loosens the trunk and works the obliques.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead.
Bend sideways, reaching over to the other side.
Return to upright.
Switch sides and repeat.

3317.description: A strongman event where you lift one side of a heavy vehicle and flip it over. It takes full body strength and leg drive.
instructions: Squat low at the edge of the vehicle with a flat back and hands underneath.
Brace your core and pull your chest up.
Drive hard through your legs and lift the edge to hip height.
Shift your hands and push up and over with your legs and arms.
Let it roll over fully, then step back and reset for the next flip.

3381.description: Pull your chest up to the underside of a sturdy table to train the back and arms using your own weight.
instructions: Lie under a sturdy table and grip the edge with both hands.
Extend your legs with heels on the floor and body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward the table edge, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower with control until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.

3509.description: A seated leg tuck, with legs pulled in then extended out. It trains the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Sit on the floor, hands behind you for support.
Lean back slightly with legs extended and lifted.
Pull your knees toward your chest.
Extend your legs back out without touching the floor.
Keep your back long and your core tight.
Breathe steadily.

3573.description: Press kettlebells overhead from the bottom of a deep squat to challenge shoulder stability and hip mobility.
instructions: Hold kettlebells in the rack position and sink into a deep squat.
Keep your chest up and heels flat.
Press the bells overhead while staying in the squat.
Lower them back to the shoulders with control.
Stand up and repeat once the set is done.

3637.description: A fast running motion while holding on to a wheel. It raises your heart rate and challenges the core and shoulders.
instructions: Start in a plank position with your hands on the wheel and your body straight.
Engage your core and start rolling the wheel forward by extending your arms.
Continue rolling until your body is fully extended and your arms are overhead.
Reverse the movement by pulling the wheel back towards your body, using your core and arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从平板支撑位置开始，双手放在方向盘上，身体伸直。
启动你的核心并通过伸展双臂开始向前滚动轮子。
继续滚动，直到身体完全伸展并且手臂举过头顶。
使用你的核心和手臂将轮子拉回你的身体，从而扭转运动。
重复所需的重复次数。

3701.description: Running in place at full speed with your knees driving high. A quick way to raise your heart rate and warm up your legs.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms bent at your sides.
Start running in place, driving each knee up to hip height.
Pump your arms in rhythm with your legs.
Stay on the balls of your feet and keep your chest up.
Go hard for 20 to 30 seconds, then rest.

3765.description: A step up with an explosive jump at the top, which builds leg power and raises your heart rate.
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box or step.
Place one foot on top.
Drive through it and jump up into the air.
Land softly on the box and step back down.
Switch legs and keep a steady rhythm.

3829.description: A lying back extension while holding a towel taut. It builds your lower back and glutes with extra upper back work.
instructions: Lie face down holding a taut towel in front of you.
Lift your chest and legs off the floor.
Keep pulling the towel apart.
Pause at the top.
Lower back down with control.

3893.description: A hard-effort ride on an air bike that gets your heart rate up and trains the legs and arms.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and sit on the bike.
Grip the handles and push and pull with your arms.
Pedal at a steady, strong pace.
Increase the effort for intervals.
Keep your breathing controlled.
Ride for a set time or distance.

4085.description: A curl performed kneeling with your upper arms braced on a bench or pad, so the biceps do the work without momentum.
instructions: Anchor the band low and kneel facing it with your upper arms resting on a bench or pad.
Hold the band ends with palms up and arms extended.
Curl your hands toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.
Keep your upper arms pressed down on the pad.

4149.description: A chest fly performed lying on the floor, which limits the range at the bottom to protect the shoulders. It isolates the pecs.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Soften your elbows slightly and keep that bend.
Open your arms wide until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause briefly without resting your weight.
Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbells back together above you.
Move slowly and keep your wrists stacked over your elbows.

4213.description: A machine chest press with bands adding extra resistance at the top. It builds the chest and triceps with a stable path.
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with your mid chest.
Sit back with your shoulder blades pinned to the pad.
Grip the handles and press forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Feel the band tension build as you lock out.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Keep your wrists straight.

4341.description: Raising one dumbbell at a time in front of you to shoulder height. It targets the front of the shoulders.
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and your torso still.
Raise one arm forward to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly as you raise the other arm.
Avoid swinging; keep alternating for your reps.

4405.description: A balancing pose with wrapped legs and arms. It stretches the hips and shoulders and builds focus.
instructions: Stand tall and bend both knees slightly.
Lift one leg and wrap it across the other thigh.
Cross your arms in front, one elbow over the other, palms together.
Lift your elbows and sink your hips slightly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

4469.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the outer thigh (lateral vastus). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your outer thigh (lateral vastus) while lying on your side.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4533.description: A forward lunge combined with an overhead press of a kettlebell. It trains legs and shoulders together.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your shoulder in the rack position.
Step forward into a lunge.
As you push back up, press the kettlebell overhead.
Lower the bell to your shoulder as you step back.
Alternate legs or finish one side before switching.

4597.description: A roundhouse-style hook kick delivered to a partner's pad, building hip rotation and power.
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a kick pad to the side.
Stand in a fighting stance with hands up.
Pivot on your standing foot and lift your rear knee out.
Rotate your hips and swing your leg in an arc into the pad.
Keep your torso steady.
Bring the leg back and switch sides.

4725.description: A chin-up variation focused on holding at the top and lowering slowly to build strength.
instructions: Jump or step up so your chin is above the bar.
Hold the top position for a few seconds.
Lower yourself slowly over several seconds.
Reset on the floor.
Repeat for the reps.

4789.description: A side squat in a wide stance, bending one leg while the other stays straight. It works the thighs, glutes and inner legs.
instructions: Stand with feet wide and your arms in front for balance.
Shift your weight to one leg and sit back and down.
Keep the other leg straight.
Keep your chest up and your heel down.
Push back to the middle and switch sides.

4853.description: A sideways lunge with dumbbells. It trains the glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest or sides.
Step wide to one side.
Sit your hips back and bend that knee.
Keep your other leg straight.
Push off to return and switch sides.

4917.description: An inverted row on a high bar, which makes the pull more upright and easier. It builds the back and arms.
instructions: Set a bar at about chest height and grab it overhand.
Walk your feet forward until your arms are straight.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself slowly.

4981.description: Barbell curl with hands placed close together. This grip puts extra emphasis on the outer part of the biceps.
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip, hands closer than shoulder width.
Keep your elbows tucked against your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders without swinging.
Squeeze your biceps at the top for a moment.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.

5045.description: A hold with your back to the floor, supported on your elbows. It strengthens the entire back of the body.
instructions: Sit with legs extended and elbows under your shoulders.
Press into your elbows and lift your hips.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.

5173.description: A standing fly motion without weights, squeezing the arms together. It teaches chest engagement and works as a warm-up.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms out wide with slightly bent elbows.
Brace your core and keep your chest proud.
Sweep your arms together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your pecs hard for a second.
Open your arms back out with control.

5237.description: A decline sit-up holding one dumbbell overhead. The load adds resistance for the abs.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured.
Hold one dumbbell with both hands above your head.
Curl up and sit forward, keeping the weight overhead.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly to the start.

5301.description: A deep squat with a kettlebell while standing on a raised platform. It increases range of motion for the legs.
instructions: Stand on a low platform holding a kettlebell at chest height.
Brace your core.
Sit your hips down as deep as you can.
Keep your chest up and heels down.
Drive through your feet to stand.
Keep the kettlebell close to your body.

5557.description: Doorway stretch for the chest and front of the shoulders.
instructions: Stand in a doorway with your forearm against the frame, elbow at shoulder height.
Step through gently with the opposite foot.
Turn away until you feel a chest stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

5813.description: A back extension on a 45 degree bench with arms crossed at the chest. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Set the pad at hip height and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lower your torso with a straight back.
Raise yourself until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and lower slowly.

6005.description: A crunch with straight legs on the floor that trains the upper abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Pause and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly without pulling on your neck.

6069.description: Alternating curls with palms facing in. It works the biceps, brachialis and forearms.
instructions: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand, palms facing your body.
Curl one bottle up without rotating your wrist.
Lower it slowly.
Curl the other arm.
Keep your elbows pinned.

6517.description: A one-arm chest-supported row on a wide handle, hitting the upper back and rear shoulder on one side.
instructions: Lean your chest on the pad and grip one wide handle.
Start with your arm extended.
Pull the handle back with your elbow flaring out.
Squeeze at the end.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

6773.description: A standing stretch for the muscle at the front of the shin. Useful after running or lots of walking.
instructions: Stand near a wall for balance.
Place the top of one foot on the floor behind you with toes curled under.
Gently bend the standing knee to press forward.
Feel the stretch along the shin.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch feet.

6901.description: A gentle spinal extension from all fours that wakes up the back and often pairs with cat pose.
instructions: Start on hands and knees, with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale and let your belly drop toward the floor.
Lift your chest and tailbone while your gaze goes slightly forward.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.
Hold for 3-5 breaths.
Return to a neutral spine.

7413.description: A hip thrust with your upper back on a bench, driving both hips up to train the glutes.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and knees bent.
Plant your feet hip-width apart.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
Repeat for the planned reps.

9653.description: A dynamic standing twist where your arms swing with the rotation. It loosens up the spine and obliques.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms relaxed.
Rotate your torso to one side, letting your arms swing around.
Let your back heel lift slightly if needed.
Rotate smoothly to the other side.
Continue at an easy rhythm for 30 seconds.

10549.description: A single-leg glute bridge with your feet raised. It strongly works the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot raised on a bench or step.
Extend the other leg straight up.
Drive through your heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

10677.description: Running with a loaded backpack to raise the effort. It builds endurance and leg strength.
instructions: Strap a snug backpack with a modest load on your back.
Start with an easy jog on flat ground.
Keep your torso tall and your steps light.
Maintain a pace where you can breathe steadily.
Cut back the load if your form suffers.
Run for 10-20 minutes.

10741.description: A standing triceps stretch with a band assisting. The band helps you ease into a deeper stretch.
instructions: Stand tall and hold a band behind your back with one hand low.
Raise the other arm overhead and bend the elbow, holding the band.
Gently pull down with the lower hand.
Feel a stretch in the back of the upper arm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch arms.

10869.description: A single-leg squat on a Bosu ball. It challenges the legs and balance.
instructions: Stand on one foot on the Bosu.
Extend your arms for balance.
Lower into a controlled squat.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Press back up.
Switch legs after the set.

10933.description: A light side-lying rotation for the back of the shoulder. Often used for shoulder stability.
instructions: Lie on your side with your top elbow bent to 90 degrees against your ribs.
Hold your forearm across your stomach.
Rotate your forearm upward without moving your elbow.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

10997.description: Lowering from a wall handstand into a tuck planche. It builds advanced shoulder strength.
instructions: Kick up into a handstand with your heels on the wall.
Brace your core and keep your arms straight.
Slowly lower your body forward.
Tuck your knees as you reach the planche position.
Control the descent and then reset.

11253.description: A straight-arm style pulldown from a kneeling position. It targets the lats without help from your legs.
instructions: Kneel facing a high pulley and hold the bar or handles with arms extended.
Sit tall with your core braced.
Pull the handle down toward your chest, driving your elbows down.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the handle rise back slowly to a full stretch.

11317.description: A back extension holding a weight plate. The plate adds resistance for the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Set up on a hyperextension bench with your feet secured and hold a plate against your chest.
Keep your back straight and body in a line.
Lower your torso with control.
Raise until you are back in a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top without overarching.

0053.description: A squat with an explosive jump while holding the bar on the upper back. Builds leg power.
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back.
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Once you reach the bottom of the squat, explode upwards by jumping off the ground.
As you jump, extend your hips, knees, and ankles, pushing through your toes.
Land softly back into the squat position and immediately repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先，双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将杠铃放在上背部。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
一旦到达深蹲底部，就从地面跳起向上爆发。
跳跃时，伸展臀部、膝盖和脚踝，推动脚趾。
轻轻地回到蹲姿，然后立即重复该动作达到所需的重复次数。

0117.description: A deadlift with a wide stance and narrow grip. Works the glutes, hamstrings and inner thighs.
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointing outwards.
Place a barbell on the ground in front of you, centered between your feet.
Bend your knees and lower your hips, keeping your back straight and chest up, to grip the barbell with an overhand grip.
Engage your core and drive through your heels to lift the barbell off the ground, extending your hips and knees simultaneously.
As you lift, keep your chest up and back straight, and push your hips forward to fully engage your glutes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开比肩宽，脚趾朝外。
将杠铃放在您面前的地面上，位于双脚之间的中心。
弯曲膝盖，降低臀部，保持背部挺直，挺胸，用正手握法抓住杠铃。
启动你的核心并通过你的脚后跟发力，将杠铃抬离地面，同时伸展你的臀部和膝盖。
当你举起时，保持胸部挺直，背部挺直，向前推动臀部以充分锻炼臀部。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置，在整个动作过程中保持控制。
重复所需的重复次数。

0181.description: A curl done lying on the floor facing a low cable, with hands close together. The lying position keeps tension on the biceps through the whole range.
instructions: Set a low pulley with a short bar and lie on your back with your feet toward the stack.
Grab the bar with a close underhand grip and arms extended.
Keep your upper arms still and curl the bar toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top for a moment.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight again.
Don't let your elbows drift away from your sides.

0245.description: A cable pulldown with an underhand grip. You pull the bar to the chest, which brings the biceps in along with the lats.
instructions: Adjust the cable machine so that the pulldown bar is at a height above your head.
Sit down on the seat and grab the pulldown bar with an underhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and lean back slightly.
Pull the bar down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the bar back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整缆绳机，使下拉杆位于您头部上方的高度。
坐在座椅上，用反手抓住下拉杆，双手分开的距离略大于肩宽。
保持背部挺直并稍微向后倾斜。
将杠铃向下拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃释放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0309.description: A dumbbell front raise lifting the weights in front to shoulder level. It trains the front delts.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your thighs.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Slowly lift the dumbbells in front of you, with your arms straight, until they are at shoulder level.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向大腿。
保持背部挺直并启动核心肌群。
慢慢举起你面前的哑铃，手臂伸直，直到与肩齐平。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0373.description: A triceps extension with a palms-down grip. It loads the back of the upper arm in a slightly different way.
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands, palms facing down, and extend your arms straight up overhead.
Keeping your upper arms close to your head and elbows pointing forward, slowly lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
双手握住哑铃，掌心朝下，双臂伸直举过头顶。
保持上臂靠近头部，肘部向前，弯曲肘部，慢慢将哑铃降低到脑后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0437.description: Standing, you pull dumbbells up along your body toward chin height. It builds the side shoulders and upper traps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Let the dumbbells hang in front of your thighs, with your arms fully extended.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, exhale and lift the dumbbells straight up towards your chin, leading with your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，正握。
让哑铃悬挂在大腿前面，双臂完全伸展。
保持背部挺直，核心收紧，呼气，将哑铃笔直向上举至下巴，用肘部引导。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0501.description: A burpee with a jumping jack at the end. It raises your heart rate and trains the whole body.
instructions: Start in a standing position with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body into a squat position, placing your hands on the ground in front of you.
Kick your feet back, landing in a push-up position.
Perform a push-up, lowering your chest to the ground and then pushing back up.
Jump your feet forward, landing in a squat position.
Jump up explosively, reaching your arms overhead.
Land softly and immediately lower back into the squat position to begin the next repetition.
instructionsZh: 从站立位置开始，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将身体降低至蹲姿，将双手放在身前的地面上。
双脚向后踢，以俯卧撑姿势落地。
进行俯卧撑，将胸部降低到地面，然后再向上推。
双脚向前跳，以蹲姿落地。
爆发性地跳起，将双臂举过头顶。
轻轻落地并立即回到蹲姿，开始下一次重复。

0565.description: Quick side-to-side steps that build foot speed and agility. It warms up the legs and trains coordination.
instructions: Stand in a slight athletic stance with knees bent.
Step quickly to one side, pushing off the opposite foot.
Bring the trailing foot in and step back the other way.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your chest up and arms moving naturally.
Work at a fast but controlled pace for the set.

0629.description: A mountain climber that steps the foot all the way outside the hand into a lunge. It raises the heart rate and opens the hips.
instructions: Start in a plank with hands under your shoulders.
Step one foot forward outside your hand.
Lower your hips into a lunge stretch.
Return the foot back to the plank.
Switch legs.
Keep your core tight and move at a steady pace.

0693.description: Seated with a straight leg, you pull your toes toward you. It stretches the calf muscles.
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight.
Loop a towel around the ball of your foot, or hold your toes.
Pull your toes toward you.
Keep your knee straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

0757.description: On an incline bench, you press the smith machine bar up. Works the upper chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Adjust the bench to a 30-45 degree incline.
Sit on the bench with your back flat against the pad and feet firmly on the ground.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and lower it slowly towards your upper chest, keeping your elbows slightly tucked in.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将长凳调整至 30-45 度倾斜。
坐在长凳上，背部平放在垫子上，双脚牢牢踩在地上。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
松开杠铃，慢慢地将其降低到上胸部，保持肘部稍微内收。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将杠铃推回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

0821.description: A sit up with a twist at the top. It adds oblique work to the usual abs focus.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands by your head.
Curl your torso up off the floor.
Rotate to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower back down with control.
Alternate sides each rep.

0885.description: A side-lying lift using the smith machine for resistance. It targets the outer hip and glutes.
instructions: Lie on your side under the bar and set it at a comfortable height.
Place your top foot or leg against the bar.
Lift the leg up smoothly against the resistance.
Lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

0949.description: An inverted V shape that stretches the back of the legs and spine while loading the shoulders. A classic yoga staple.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with hands slightly ahead of shoulders.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back.
Straighten your legs as far as comfortable and press your chest toward your thighs.
Spread your fingers and push the floor away.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
